title: Speed Up Construction of Jurong Region MRT Line with Resources Diverted from Delayed Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail Project
what_it_is: Speed Up Construction of Jurong Region MRT Line with Resources Diverted from Delayed Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail Project

sections.label: Jurong Region Line project details
sections.summary: The Jurong Region Line, Singapore's seventh MRT line, is scheduled to open in three stages between 2026 and 2028, covering 24 kilometres with 24 stations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The Jurong Region Line (JRL) will be our seventh Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) Line, after the Thomson-East Coast Line.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: It is scheduled to open in three stages between 2026 and 2028.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: It will cover 24 kilometres with 24 stations, of which, five are interchange stations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Its planning and design works have commenced since March 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: This is a complex project, and its 10-year project implementation timeline has been carefully adopted to ensure the safety and quality of construction.

sections.label: HSR-related works during suspension
sections.summary: LTA does not recommend further shortening the construction timeline, and no HSR-related works will be done during the suspension period once wind-down activities are complete.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: LTA does not recommend further shortening the construction timeline, even if additional resources are available, but we will try.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I just want to ask the Minister whether he has any answer for the third part of my question, specifically, whether there are any ancillary works or projects relating to or incidental to the HSR which will still continue in these two years?

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: That was in my answer, that during this rail suspension period, once the activities that need to be wound down are done, there will no more HSR-related works to be done during the suspension period.

sections.label: HSR tender aborted after suspension
sections.summary: The tender's closing date was postponed to end of this year, but after project construction was suspended, all bidders were informed the tender has been aborted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Probably some contract sum offered is well within the budget, most likely can be considered?

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We postponed the closing date to end of this year but now that the project construction has been suspended, on the same day, we have informed all the bidders that the tender has been aborted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The tender's closing date is end of this year.
